upgrades.name: Sharpened
upgrades.description: Deal 20% more damage.

upgrades.name: Quick Spin
upgrades.description: Your weapon spins 20% faster.

upgrades.name: Long Blade
upgrades.description: Your weapon is 20% longer.

upgrades.name: Heavy Blade
upgrades.description: Your weapon is 50% thicker, so it hits and blocks more.

upgrades.name: Compact
upgrades.description: Your ball is 12% smaller: a harder target.

upgrades.name: Thorns
upgrades.description: Whoever hits you takes 30% of the damage back.

upgrades.name: Vitality
upgrades.description: +25 max HP.

upgrades.name: Swift
upgrades.description: Your ball moves 15% faster.

upgrades.name: Focus
upgrades.description: Your ability cooldown is 25% shorter (each copy shortens what is left).

upgrades.name: Armor
upgrades.description: Take 1 less damage from every hit (but never less than half).

upgrades.name: Lifesteal
upgrades.description: Hits heal you for 25% of the damage dealt.

upgrades.name: Critical Hits
upgrades.description: 15% chance for a hit to deal double damage.

upgrades.name: Extra Blade
upgrades.description: Adds another copy of your weapon.

upgrades.name: Shield Bash
upgrades.description: Blocking a hit with your shield deals 1 damage back.

upgrades.name: Wide Swipe
upgrades.description: Your sword is 40% longer during Spin Swipe.

upgrades.name: Spiked Shield
upgrades.description: Your shield deals 2 damage to enemies it touches.

upgrades.name: Long Swipe
upgrades.description: Spin Swipe keeps spinning for an extra half turn.

upgrades.name: Big Shield
upgrades.description: Your shield is 50% wider.

upgrades.name: Long Dash
upgrades.description: Charge Dash travels 40% further.

upgrades.name: Quick Charge
upgrades.description: Charge Dash winds up twice as fast (each copy halves what is left).

upgrades.name: Braced
upgrades.description: Take 60% less damage while charging and dashing (each copy cuts what is left).

upgrades.name: Rapid Growth
upgrades.description: Your spear grows 50% more with every hit.

upgrades.name: Deadly Crits
upgrades.description: Critical hits deal +100% damage (triple instead of double).

upgrades.name: Quick Recovery
upgrades.description: Your daggers can parry the same weapon again twice as soon (each copy halves what is left).

upgrades.name: Momentum
upgrades.description: Your daggers gain 50% more spin speed per hit.

upgrades.name: Close Quarters
upgrades.description: Your hits knock enemies back 40% less, keeping them in reach (each copy cuts what is left).

upgrades.name: Evasion
upgrades.description: +12% chance to dodge a hit completely.

upgrades.name: Rebound
upgrades.description: Bouncing off a wall makes you 40% faster for a moment.

upgrades.name: Quick Drop
upgrades.description: Drop Slam hangs in the air for 60% less time before falling (each copy cuts what is left).

upgrades.name: Heavy Impact
upgrades.description: Drop Slam gains 50% more damage from the height it falls.

upgrades.name: High Bounce
upgrades.description: Drop Slam bounces you back up off the floor at +100% speed.

upgrades.name: Great Mace
upgrades.description: Your mace is 40% longer during Drop Slam.

upgrades.name: Meteor
upgrades.description: Drop Slam starts falling faster and accelerates 50% harder.

transformations.name: Stalwart
transformations.description: Gain a second, smaller shield. Both sit behind you in a Y, with your sword as its stem. The weight slows your spin by 15%.

transformations.name: Wildling
transformations.description: Landing a hit with Spin Swipe wards you: the next hit you take does nothing.

transformations.name: Dizzy
transformations.description: Spin Swipe spins two extra full turns.

transformations.name: Captain
transformations.description: Every 4 s, throw your shield at the enemy for 2 damage (plus its own contact damage, like spikes). It flies back to you, but can't block while it's away.

transformations.name: Fire Eater
transformations.description: Every 3 s your blade catches fire. Your next hit sets the enemy burning for 1 damage every 0.5 s for 3 s.

transformations.name: Piercer
transformations.description: After every Spin Swipe, lunge at the enemy sword-first for a big stab. Spin Swipe's cooldown is 50% longer.

transformations.name: Dual Wielder
transformations.description: Swap your shield for a short second sword. It still blocks, deals 3 damage to enemies it touches (+0.5 each time your sword hits), and gets your shield upgrades.

transformations.name: Gladiator
transformations.description: Every 4 s, throw a net at the enemy. If it lands they're 50% slower and take 50% more damage for 2.5 s.

transformations.name: Hoplite
transformations.description: Gain a shield like the Sword's, just to the left of your spear. It blocks enemy weapons.

transformations.name: Poseidon
transformations.description: Your spear becomes a trident with a big head. Hitting with the head skewers the enemy: they are carried on it for 0.7 s, then take a second hit at half damage and are flung off.

transformations.name: Dancer
transformations.description: Every 5 s, when the enemy is close, whirl your spear through a fast full turn (like Spin Swipe) for 30% more damage.

transformations.name: Bouncer
transformations.description: Landing a hit sends out a repelling pulse as far as your spear reaches, dealing 3 damage and throwing enemies straight away from you (at most once a second).

transformations.name: Olympian
transformations.description: Charge Dash becomes Spear Throw: hurl your spear for double damage and huge knockback, then dash to pick it up, ramming enemies on the way. Unarmed until you catch it.

transformations.name: Tactician
transformations.description: Your spear head is longer, and hits with it always crit. Hits with the shaft deal 40% less damage.

transformations.name: Tackler
transformations.description: When your spear clashes with a weapon or shield, the enemy's guard breaks for 2.5 s: their weapon and shields can't block, and weapons pass straight through them.

transformations.name: Runner
transformations.description: Every parry takes 1 s off your Charge Dash's cooldown.
